candidates.statement: Order service calls to payment (/v1/authorizations) hit ReadTimeout (~2s) on every checkout trace, while inventory/redis calls succeed in ms. The order service's own POST /v1/orders then returns 502 to gateway, producing gateway /v1/checkout 502s at ~2s. Root cause is payment downstream latency exceeding the order client timeout.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side spans/metrics; payment latency cause (saturation vs. slow dependency) unconfirmed. Redis and inventory are healthy, ruling out redis-timeout.

report.explanation: Traces show consistent ReadTimeout on order->payment calls (~2s) while inventory/redis succeed quickly; order returns 502 to gateway, yielding gateway checkout 502s at ~2s. Bounded to downstream-latency at payment. Payment-side telemetry absent, so payment-internal cause remains unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service server-side latency/error metrics or spans for /v1/authorizations
Order service client timeout configuration to confirm timeout threshold
Payment dependency (DB/external) health during incident window
